# Beats16 Events & Entertainment

Beats16 is a live music company in Mumbai, started by Tushar Sonigra. It plays Indian weddings and traditional festivals, in India and abroad.

Site: https://beats16-events.vercel.app

## Bands

- Gauri: wedding rituals and traditional ceremonies, including the pheras. https://beats16-events.vercel.app/gauri
- RDX: wireless band for sangeet nights and private events. https://beats16-events.vercel.app/rdx
- Daastan-e-Ghazal: ghazal evenings for cultural programmes, community gatherings and private events. https://beats16-events.vercel.app/daastan-e-ghazal
- Navratri band by Beats16: live garba and dandiya. Beats16 has organised 80+ Navratris. https://beats16-events.vercel.app/navratri
- Independent bands: put together for private shows that are not one of the four bands above.

## Record

- 5,000+ events, weddings and festivals
- 80+ Navratris organised
- Home base: Mumbai
- Performs across India and abroad

## What Beats16 plays

Indian weddings, including mehendi, sangeet, pheras and reception. Traditional festivals such as Navratri. Also cultural programmes, religious celebrations, community gatherings and corporate events.

Beats16 specialises in Indian weddings and traditional festivals. For a different kind of ceremony, they say so plainly and kindly.

Pricing is discussed personally once they know the date, city and functions. Dates are confirmed only after a conversation with Tushar Sonigra.
